name: create-skill-tools
title: Create skill
description: Create, improve, audit, refactor, evaluate, package, and publish portable agent skills. Use for new skills, trigger fixes, MECE skill ownership, SkillOpt-style loops, Companion-compatible packaging, and skill-system architecture work.
notes:
## What it does

Skill Creator guides the full lifecycle for portable agent skills: drafting SKILL.md, designing shareable file formats, creating realistic eval prompts, running with-skill and baseline comparisons, reviewing qualitative and quantitative results, auditing skill surfaces, refactoring overlapping owners, and preparing Companion-ready packages.

## Portability

The skill avoids hard-coded personal paths, private organization context, and secret values. Distribution metadata lives in companion.json; local project rules should be treated as per-workspace overlays, not baked into the shareable package.

## Runtime notes

Most guidance is host-agnostic. Some optional eval and description-improvement scripts use the local agent CLI available in the current environment. If a host lacks subagents or browser access, use the documented manual or static-output fallback.

changes: Replace model activation reporting with automatic Skillpack runtime collection.
Include Skillpack activation reporting with optional identity, telemetry opt-out, and non-blocking delivery.
Added clean skill-structure guidance inspired by high-quality public skill repositories.
Added a self-evaluation suite covering creation, bounded improvement, audits, trigger optimization, wrong-owner routing, and packaging.
Standardized eval terminology on expectations across SKILL.md, schemas, grader guidance, self-evals, and the review viewer.
Added usage history analysis for Codex and Claude conversations so skill updates can be proposed from real usage evidence.
Renamed the Companion slug from skill-creator-and-eval to skill-creator after moving the archived legacy skill out of the way.
Expanded Skill Creator into the owner for portable skill-system audits, MECE refactors, trigger fixes, Companion readiness, and SkillOpt-light loops.
Added shareable package format guidance and a portable skill-system audit script.
Kept the stable Companion slug skill-creator-and-eval for this upload while a legacy archived skill still held the skill-creator slug.
Initial Companion package for the Skill Creator and Eval workflow.

commands.name: Create a skill

commands.desc: Optimize a skill frontmatter description for better trigger accuracy.

commands.name: Audit skill system
commands.desc: Inventory a skill surface, detect overlaps and portability issues, and produce a scoped proposal.

commands.name: Refactor skills
commands.desc: Merge, split, retire, or migrate skills with snapshots, approval gates, and validation.

commands.desc: Check that SKILL.md and companion.json are portable and ready for sharing.

commands.desc: Scan local Codex and Claude conversations for how a skill was used, where it failed, and what update to propose.
